name: Campaigner
summary: Email and SMS marketing for mid-market senders with larger lists. Contact-based pricing bills dormant subscribers too.
best_for: mid-market senders with larger lists that want mature email plus SMS workflows and are comfortable at the Essential tier and up
skip_if: you're small (the useful features start at $179/mo) or you dislike card-required auto-converting trials on principle
honest_knock: Two paragraphs of fine print worth reading. Automation workflows and conversion tracking only arrive on Advanced (from $35 a month at 1,000 contacts) — Essentials is a sending tool with an API, not a marketing-automation platform — and the trial auto-converts to paid if you do not actively cancel, which tells you something about the retention strategy. Contact-based pricing also means dormant subscribers bill like active ones; prune first.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month at 1,000 contacts, but automation starts on Advanced at $35/mo
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-09-05 on campaigner.com/pricing) Campaigner prices by contact count and bills per account, not per user: a slider sets the tier and there is no separate monthly/annual toggle. Two self-serve plans: Essentials from $14 a month at 1,000 contacts ($38 at 5,000, $158 at 25,000, $409 at 100,000) and Advanced from $35 a month at 1,000 contacts ($70 at 5,000, $258 at 25,000, $649 at 100,000), plus a quote-only Custom tier. Essentials excludes automation workflows and conversion tracking but includes the REST API, webhooks and SFTP; landing pages, sub-accounts and white-label are Custom only. SMS/MMS is not bundled into any plan: pay-as-you-go from $0.009 per message, sold through sales. Reputation Defender is an add-on at 20% of plan cost. The 30-day trial is full-feature but takes a card and auto-charges when it ends. History: until July 2026 the page carried a Starter/Essential/Advanced ladder at about $59, $179 and $649 a month; the current ladder starts far lower and moves with the contact count.
